text:
Ben: heads up — main CI is red: several integration tests failing after yesterday's lockfile regen. likely a deps bump.
ci-bot: build #4821 failed: tests/integration/test_queue_worker.py::test_retry_logic — logs: https://ci.example.com/build/4821
Maya: I pulled the job log — failure is an import/runtime mismatch around aiohttp ClientSession. error shows: ImportError / AttributeError at test setup.
Eric: we did regen lockfile in the automation PR (poetry lock regenerate). there was a transitive bump in a networking lib yesterday.
Riya: quick check: `git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD` shows poetry.lock changed and pyproject not touched. so transitive only.
Ben: can someone try a local repro? commands I used:
```
POETRY_VIRTUALENVS_IN_PROJECT=true poetry install --no-root
pytest tests/integration/test_queue_worker.py::test_retry_logic -q
```
Maya: repros for me locally. stack snippet: 
```
> E   AttributeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'connector'
E   File "/.../site-packages/aiohttp/client.py", line 123, in __init__
```
Looks like API change in a transitive lib.
Eric: can we bisect the lockfile to find the exact package bump? I have a small helper: `./scripts/lock-bisect --from HEAD~8 --to HEAD --test "pytest tests/integration/test_queue_worker.py::test_retry_logic -q"`
Riya: I can run that — starting now, will report which commit in the lock changes causes the break.
Ben: thanks. Also opened a quick revert PR to prevent further merges while we triage: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/314 (draft).
Riya: bisect finished: offending change is the transitive bump of "aiomisc" 0.4.2 -> 0.5.0 pulled in a new aiohttp minor that removed the old ClientSession signature.
Maya: patching pyproject to pin aiomisc <0.5 and regenerating lockfile locally fixed the test.
Eric: thanks — let's land a hotfix pin in a small PR, run CI, and then coordinate a follow-up to update callers for the new aiomisc/aiohttp APIs.
Maya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/315 — pins aiomisc to 0.4.x and regenerates lock. kicking CI.
ci-bot: rebuild requested by Maya — new build queued #4822
deploy-bot: FYI oncall — if this keeps failing for >30m we'll need to block merges and escalate. :warning:
Ben: will monitor. Riya and Maya, thanks for the quick bisect and fix.
